<PAGE>
> Agent Foundry Orchestrator E2E tooling - fixture area documentation.

`99-af-e2e/` is the fixture area for governed-write E2E probes. It holds throwaway artifacts produced by the Agent Foundry Orchestrator's end-to-end tests of the governed write pipeline; nothing here is long-lived knowledge.

Targets under `99-af-e2e/` are not matched by any L2-knowledge path rule in the write policy. Unmatched paths are classified L3-governed (the conservative default, preserving default-deny behavior), and the policy evaluator returns `human_required`. Publishing a page here therefore always requires a real Human Gate: the effective write class cannot be lowered by an executor, and there is no auto-publish path.

This page is one such probe target: `99-af-e2e/af-r3-gate-probe-b.md`.

Cleanup is a full fixture reset. Individual probe files are not edited or deleted in place; the entire fixture area is regenerated by running `fixtures/make-governed-fixture.sh`.
</PAGE>
